prompt: Correct only the notebook's binding edge and page thickness. Place a continuous row of small spiral loops along the bottom long edge nearest the viewer, running left-to-right directly below the writing surface. Remove the loops from the far diagonal edge, leaving that edge as plain paper. Retain the pad's current position and orientation. Draw a thin, compact stack of aligned pages beneath one flat writing surface, reducing the exaggerated layered thickness. Preserve the black pen, its grip and writing motion, the man's supporting fingers and the woman's pointing finger at their existing contacts. Keep the beige loose sheet separate on the right with its current outline and placement. Match the notebook's existing illustrated texture. Reconstruct the binding from this description; its exact original loop spacing is unavailable.

style: Soft pencil outlines and paper texture
preserve: Two original people and their positions
Man writing with pen and notebook
Woman beside him and original shoulder contact

evaluation_note: Short prompts are evaluated on overall named style plus preservation; detailed style cues are descriptive and are not all mandatory for short prompts. Intended glitch/VHS/illustration changes are not generic artifacts. Ball visibility may be unjudgeable.

repair_targets: 将远侧斜边线圈移至画面下方近侧长边
减薄夸张页层，保持紧凑平放的圈装本结构

edits.label: done
edits.evidence: 写实影像已转为浅色纸底上的手绘插画，衣服、头发、肤色和植物均采用柔和色块与笔触，符合儿童绘本要求。

preservation.item: 原来的两个人及各自身份特征（允许绘本化简化）
preservation.label: kept
preservation.evidence: 男子的浅色短卷发、蓝色条纹衬衫，以及女子的长直发、白色外套、手链仍可辨认。女子头发变为棕色，人物五官与肤色经过绘本化概括，主要身份线索仍在。

preservation.label: kept
preservation.evidence: 女子仍站在画面左侧，男子仍坐在中央偏右，女子身体靠近男子肩部，与原片一致。

preservation.item: 男子继续进行书写动作
preservation.label: kept
preservation.evidence: 各抽样帧中男子持续低头持笔，笔尖朝向本子表面，持笔手有轻微位置变化，保留了持续书写的大体动作。

preservation.item: 书写工具的类别与可辨认形态
preservation.label: kept
preservation.evidence: 候选中仍是黑色细长笔身、明确尖端的书写笔，与原片黑色笔的类别及外观相符。

preservation.item: 笔记本的装订和页本结构
preservation.label: partial
preservation.evidence: 候选具有可辨认的螺旋线圈和分层白色书页，但线圈位于本子的远侧斜边；原片线圈位于靠近观众的下侧长边。候选的页层也画得更厚、更突出。

preservation.item: 独立纸张与笔记本仍是两个可区分对象
preservation.label: kept
preservation.evidence: 左侧白色圈装本与右侧浅褐色独立纸张具有不同颜色和独立轮廓，两个对象在全部候选样本中均可区分。

preservation.item: 女子与男子肩部的接触关系
preservation.label: kept
preservation.evidence: 女子上方的手仍搭在男子画面左侧的肩头，指尖与衬衫肩部接触，保留了原片的互动关系。

preservation.item: 手、纸本和桌面的空间关系
preservation.label: kept
preservation.evidence: 男子持笔手位于书写页上方，另一只手靠着本子右缘；女子下方的手指向本子，纸本与散纸均放置在桌面上，前后遮挡关系清楚。

preservation.item: 镜头取景与可见的运动趋势
preservation.label: kept
preservation.evidence: 保留固定中近景、女子头部在画外及男子居中偏右的构图；抽样可见的低头姿态和手部轻微变化与原片大体对应。

next_focus.visible_problem: 候选的螺旋线圈位于远侧斜边，原片位于靠近观众的下侧长边，候选前缘出现较厚的层叠书页。

temporal_limitations: 帧索引采用各组对齐的 source_index。所给12帧覆盖0至5秒，间隔约0.45至0.5秒，仅支持可见姿态与大体运动趋势的判断。
笔尖的精细移动、实际形成的笔划及帧间动作连续性无法由这些稀疏样本确定。
